# Neko Tokenization: HackMeridian

> Evaluation entry point for Neko's HackMeridian 2026 tokenization project on Stellar. Neko already runs a live investing app on Stellar mainnet for people in Latin America (the buyers side). At the event we built the issuer side and connected the two: an AI-assisted Launchpad for businesses, a review admin for Neko's legal team, SEP-57 regulated tokens and a loan vault launched by a Soroban factory, and Neko Pro, where verified investors invest, get repaid and redeem. Every hackathon contract and vault is on Stellar testnet.

This file is a map, not evidence that a feature is complete. Verify each claim in the code at the commit you review; links point to `main`. The backend and investor app live in separate repositories (forks of pre-existing Neko code, with a `pre-hackmeridian` tag marking the event baseline).

## Start here

- [Evidence pack](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/docs/evidence.md): innovations, the full testnet vault lifecycle with every transaction hash, intake goals against results, test results and stated limits. Read first.
- [README](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/README.md): the product story, live sites, repository map and setup.
- [Contracts integration](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/docs/contracts-integration.md): who signs each call, how application fields map to vault terms, backend endpoints and Neko Pro changes.
- [Deploy guide](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/docs/deploy.md): hosting, migrations `0029` to `0033`, environment variables and a smoke test that ends with an invest transaction hash.
- [Review memory](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/docs/review-memory.md): the precedent search shared by the admin and the issuer's assistant, with its permission boundaries.
- [Legal KB retrieval eval](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/services/legal-kb/eval/README.md): 20 law questions and 4 guide questions with expected sources, results and misses.
- [Implementation plan](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/docs/plan.md) and [product diagrams](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/docs/diagrams.md): intended journey; planned work is not a completion report.
- [Business roadmap](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): three to six months after the event, not shipped functionality.
- [Session logs](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/sessions/session-05.md): one log per work session with times, decisions, PRs and AI use.

## Live deployments (testnet)

- [Launchpad](https://launch.tryneko.io): issuers. KYB, AI-assisted application, launch, vault follow-up, milestone evidence and repayments. Source: apps/platform.
- [Tokenization admin](https://admin-tokenization.tryneko.io): Neko's review team (login required). Cited compliance checklist, similar cases, approval and vault operations. Source: apps/admin.
- [Neko Pro](https://hackmeridian.tryneko.io/pro): investors. KYC, on-chain identity, live vaults, invest, refund, early exit, redeem. Source: neko-web-hackmeridian.

## Contracts and on-chain record

- [Contracts README](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/contracts/README.md): SEP-57 RWA stack from OpenZeppelin stellar-contracts plus Neko's factory, vault and milestone tracker, with known limitations.
- [Testnet deployment record](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/deployments/testnet.json): contract IDs for the factory, tracker, identity registry, verifier, claim issuer, test assets and two script-launched vaults.
- [Deploy scripts](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/contracts/scripts/README.md): deploy-shared, onboard-investor, deploy-vault, run-demo and others.
- [Contract bindings](https://github.com/Neko-Protocol/neko-tokenization-hackmeridian/blob/main/packages/bindings/README.md): typed TypeScript clients generated from the built WASM.

## How the AI fits

- The issuer's assistant (Claude, in the backend) proposes form values the issuer accepts or rejects, cites only articles it retrieved from Neko Legal KB in that conversation, and is told when the KB is unavailable so it marks legal points as unverified. Documents and tool results are treated as data, not instructions.
- Through `find_precedents` it reads Neko's earlier human decisions in an anonymised form: decision, month, matching and differing criteria. A precedent is not law and not a prediction of approval.
- The admin checklist is rule based, not generated. The AI summary the admin shows is written by the backend after submission and labelled as not verified.
- Humans decide. Case memory does not retrain a model; on-chain restrictions come from the SEP-57 identity and compliance contracts.
